description: Flagship. Independent third-party decision for an Irish supplier invoice. Runs five gates (CRO status NORMAL, EU VIES VAT, payee-name and IBAN check, PO/GRN/invoice 3-way match, RSA signature) and returns exactly one of EXECUTE_PAYMENT, REJECT_PAYMENT or FLAG_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW with per-check results, reason codes and a confidence score. The legacy CONFIRMATION_OF_PAYEE result means a payee-name comparison with the CRO legal name and IBAN validation, not bank Confirmation of Payee. ERP_THREE_WAY_MATCH compares caller-supplied documents, not independently verified ERP records. Decides only; never moves money. Register a signing key first via /v1/agent-keys. Use this for the complete signed invoice/PO/GRN workflow, not verify_supplier_payment's separate identity/VAT contract or get_verification retrieval. Provider uncertainty requires review, not execution; retain independent payment approval. Supply a stable transaction_id for retries and never automatically repay.

quantity.description: Positive ordered or invoiced quantity; send an exact decimal string.
quantity.title: Quantity

sku.description: Item identifier used consistently across invoice, PO and receipt.
sku.title: Sku

unit_price.description: Nonnegative unit price in the document currency; send an exact decimal string.
unit_price.title: Unit Price

goods_receipt.description: Caller-supplied goods receipt with quantities received against the same PO.

invoice.description: Invoice being reviewed, including payee name, amount, currency, PO/GRN references and line items.

purchase_order.description: Caller-supplied purchase order to compare with the invoice; no ERP lookup is performed.

signature.description: RSA-PSS SHA-256 signature of the normalized canonical request without signature, using a previously registered public-key ID in the same tenant.

supplier.description: Supplier CRO number, Irish VAT number and claimed payment IBAN for all five gates.

transaction_id.description: Stable caller transaction identifier for the same business request. Reuse on retries; changed content with the same ID conflicts.
transaction_id.title: Transaction Id

SignatureEnvelope.description: RSA signature over the canonical JSON of the request body, plus mTLS evidence.
SignatureEnvelope.title: SignatureEnvelope

cro_number.description: Irish CRO company number for the invoice supplier; preserve it as a string.
cro_number.title: Cro Number

iban.description: Supplier's claimed payment IBAN. Validation does not independently establish account ownership.
iban.title: Iban

vat_number.description: Supplier Irish VAT number to validate and check against EU VIES, not a CRO number.
vat_number.title: Vat Number

payment_request.description: Decide: pay this supplier invoice or not: supply this structured object using the nested schema, not a JSON-encoded string.

name: decide_supplier_payment
